If Christmas Day falls on a Friday, on what day of the week is the following New Year's Day?
why: New Year's Day is exactly seven days after Christmas Day, so it falls on the same weekday.

text: In 'The Twelve Days of Christmas', how many gifts are given altogether over the twelve days?
why: Day n brings 1 + 2 + … + n gifts; adding those totals for days 1 to 12 gives 364.

text: In 'The Twelve Days of Christmas', how many geese a-laying are given altogether?
why: Six geese arrive on each of days 6 to 12: that is 7 days × 6 = 42.
